comments.comment:
"Rajeev Mishra <rajeevm@hpe.com>" uploaded a new patch: https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/63511
Subject: LU-19809 utils: Fix lfs migrate to return correct exit code
Project: fs/lustre-release
Branch: master
Current Patch Set: 1
Commit: e5254f22fee224cc50df6b8d0fc2732bdf3a377b

It looks like this patch has exposed an issue related to migrating a directory with encrypted files in it.

It looks like the patch is repeatedly failing conf-sanity test_32c during file migration. LU-18348 relates to interop issues with accessing the key while calculating the sha1sum of the file, but this is failing during the migrate step. I suspect it is also failing without this patch, but is silently ignored because no error is being returned:

== test migration ==
/tmp/t32/mnt/lustre /usr/lib64/lustre/tests
lfs migrate: cb_migrate_mdt_fini: error completing migration of ./.fscrypt: Directory not empty (39)
/usr/lib64/lustre/tests
 conf-sanity test_32c: @@@@@@ FAIL: migrate MDT1 failed

I will analyze the test and fix the issue
== test migration ==
/tmp/t32/mnt/lustre /usr/lib64/lustre/tests
lfs migrate: cb_migrate_mdt_fini: error completing migration of ./.fscrypt: Directory not empty (39)
/usr/lib64/lustre/tests
conf-sanity test_32c: @@@@@@ FAIL: migrate MDT1 failed
thanks Andreas

the issue was related to dir not being empty
